products.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint — Commercial
products.short_description: The complete Microsoft Defender for Endpoint solution — deploy, operate, optimize, enable your team, and prove value, end to end.
products.description:
The complete Microsoft Defender for Endpoint solution — deploy, operate, optimize, enable your team, and prove value, end to end.

Most teams stand up Defender for Endpoint halfway, never tune it, and never upskill the SOC. This comprehensive solution takes MDE end to end: full onboarding (Windows/macOS/Linux, EDR block mode, ASR, tamper protection, web filtering, device groups/RBAC, live response, vulnerability management), operational optimization (tune ASR audit→block, cut false positives, expand coverage), hands-on team enablement labs, and a guided proof-of-concept — one product, the whole lifecycle.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • End-to-end deployment & onboarding (config, coverage, pilot-first rollout)
  • Operations & optimization — tune, reduce noise, expand coverage, harden policy
  • Hands-on enablement labs to upskill your admins/SOC on the product
  • A guided proof-of-concept / pilot with benign test signal to prove value
  • Read-only discovery, validation & reporting scripts (PowerShell + KQL)

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A fully deployed, tuned, team-ready Defender for Endpoint that demonstrably works — the entire lifecycle in one comprehensive package.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 7 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDEFULL-Discovery.ps1 — read-only lifecycle readiness for Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
    • MDEFULL-Hunt.ps1 — read-only KQL advanced-hunting for the Defender for Endpoint lifecycle:
    • MDEFULL-PoC.ps1 — the guided Microsoft Defender for Endpoint proof-of-concept in one script
    • MDEFULL-PromoteASR.ps1 — promote audit-vetted ASR rules from audit to BLOCK on the pilot ring
    • MDEFULL-Report.ps1 — coverage + ASR-audit + noise + TVM exposure report for Defender for Endpoint,
    • MDEFULL-RunLab.ps1 — run a chosen endpoint hunting-lab query from MDEFULL-Labs.kql read-only
    • MDEFULL-Validate.ps1 — targeted validation across the Defender for Endpoint lifecycle

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
